    The radical of a finite scalar mesh category is its positive part #

    For a finite-dimensional scalar mesh category C(Q, c), the morphisms of degree at least m (Ge m) are closed under composition with degrees adding (ge_comp), vanish for m large (exists_ge_eq_zero), and a morphism is radical (1 - fg invertible for all g) exactly when its degree-zero part vanishes (radical_iff). This is the input gr_J C = C of the proof of Corollary 4.15 (scalar-normalization.tex).
